keyPhrases: A lot of Veterans assume they'll just figure it out later, but the reality is that getting these documents in order now makes things so much easier for your loved ones down the road.
This program is set up so when something happens to you, your family will have the necessary documents to carry out your wishes.
It's a no-cost service for veterans.
summary: The call effectively opened with a clear introduction and purpose, establishing rapport with the veteran. The agent skillfully handled objections by providing reassurance and emphasizing the benefits of professional assistance, ultimately leading to a successful appointment setup.
